description: This file defines a React hook and a utility controller for progressively applying work (such as expanding nodes) in batches, optimizing UI responsiveness by yielding control back to the main thread using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback. It exports a function to create a controller for batching work and a React hook to manage its state within React components.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object to manage batched processing of work items, with start and cancel capabilities, progress reporting, and adaptive batch sizing based on total items.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the controller to provide UI state management, including progress percentage, running status, and control functions for starting and canceling batch processing.
